evidence_quotes.O: While this camera may look like some of the micro 4/3 replaceable lens cameras, it actually uses the sensors found commonly on small point and shoots.
evidence_quotes.C: Essentially comparing specs to specs, the airport extreme (the current new version) and this router are essentially the same.
evidence_quotes.E: I worked in customer service for awhile, and most that I've known use plantronics headsets.
evidence_quotes.A: The downside is that you only get a relatively small screen, but for the majority of people out there, it's going to be good enough.
evidence_quotes.N: If I was using other headphones, I would need to turn up the value to cancel it out, leaving me with a headache.
